ui_bugs.issue: After successful save, the form calls router.back(). When the screen is opened via a deep link (e.g. /customer/new directly, or after login redirect flow), the router has no back-stack and the RN Navigation console warns 'GO_BACK was not handled by any navigator.' The customer IS created but the user is stranded on the form. Recommend router.replace(`/customer/${newId}`) instead of router.back().

FIX APPLIED by testing agent (removed the Image import from react-native — expo-image is used everywhere in this file).

rca_of_issue: One blocking bug found and fixed by testing agent: /app/frontend/app/customer/[id].tsx had `import { Image } from 'react-native'` and `import { Image } from 'expo-image'` back-to-back (lines 2 and 4) — Babel raised 'Identifier Image has already been declared' and the entire Metro bundle failed for iOS/Android/Web. Fix: dropped Image from the react-native import (expo-image is used at both call sites at lines 86 and 207). Everything else worked as designed.
